selected_evidence.requirement: Persistent config file created and applied
selected_evidence.summary: Wrote /etc/sysctl.d/60-disable-icmp-redirects-source-route.conf and applied with sysctl --system; output shows all/default accept_redirects=0 and accept_source_route=0 took effect

selected_evidence.requirement: Live kernel state fully consistent across interfaces before restart
selected_evidence.summary: Per-interface /proc/sys checks showed enp1s0/lo accept_redirects still 1 after sysctl --system (stale pre-existing interface state); explicitly set enp1s0 and lo accept_redirects=0 live and reconfirmed all/default/source_route values

selected_evidence.requirement: Pre-restart boot identity captured immediately before reboot
selected_evidence.summary: Re-confirmed boot_id bf4e9cbb-84f9-45f0-9b81-6602b98cea07 unchanged just before issuing reboot
systemctl reboot issued; exec stream closed as expected, confirming the reboot command was accepted and the node went down

selected_evidence.requirement: Node restart occurred (changed boot identity) and command execution recovered
selected_evidence.summary: Polled node1 through connection timeouts/reset during reboot until reachable again; boot_id read as ea140a49-71f2-473f-ad64-5f0f3940cfc1, proving a genuine restart occurred (differs from pre-restart bf4e9cbb...)

selected_evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery and persistence of the hardening settings
selected_evidence.summary: After reboot, sysctl shows all/default accept_redirects=0 and accept_source_route=0, enp1s0 accept_redirects=0/accept_source_route=0, and the /etc/sysctl.d config file is intact — confirming the settings persisted across the restart

commands.command:
for f in /proc/sys/net/ipv4/conf/*/accept_redirects; do echo "$f: $(cat $f)"; done
for f in /proc/sys/net/ipv4/conf/*/accept_source_route; do echo "$f: $(cat $f)"; done

sudo sysctl -w net.ipv4.conf.enp1s0.accept_redirects=0
for f in /proc/sys/net/ipv4/conf/*/accept_redirects; do echo "$f: $(cat $f)"; done

sudo sysctl -w net.ipv4.conf.lo.accept_redirects=0
sysctl net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_redirects net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_redirects net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_source_route net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_source_route
sudo systemctl reboot & sleep 1; echo "reboot issued"
